user.title: Your energy. Decides together.
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to fluks and choose how you want to get started.

menu_option_descriptions.register: Create a new account and verify your email.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Log in to connect Home Assistant to your fluks account.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Create a fluks account. We'll email you a six-digit verification code next.

menu_option_descriptions.verify: Enter the six-digit code from your email.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.description: We sent a six-digit verification code to {email}. Enter it below; you can retry if the code is not accepted.

verification_resent.title: Request received
verification_resent.description: Another verification email has been requested for {email}.

menu_option_descriptions.verify: Continue with the six-digit code from your email.
menu_option_descriptions.resend_verification: Request again if you still have not received it.

site_choice.title: Choose where to connect
site_choice.description: Select an existing fluks Site or create a new one.

menu_option_descriptions.site: Connect this Home Assistant to one of your Sites.
menu_option_descriptions.create_site: Set up a new place for your energy devices.

site.title: Choose a Site
site.description: Select the fluks Site this Home Assistant belongs to.

create_site.title: Name your Site
create_site.description: Give this place a clear name, such as Home.

data_description.site_name: Home Assistant supplies the required location details automatically.

register_integration.title: Finish connecting
register_integration.description: fluks could not finish connecting this Home Assistant. Submit to try again safely.

error.cannot_connect: We couldn't reach fluks. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or password is incorrect.
error.invalid_input: Check the highlighted information and try again.
error.invalid_verification_code: That code is invalid or no longer available. Check the email and try again.
error.invalid_verification_code_format: Enter the six digits from your email.
error.resend_cannot_connect: Could not request another verification email. Check your connection and try again.
error.resend_invalid_input: Could not request another verification email. Check the email address and try again.
error.resend_unknown: Could not request another verification email. Please try again.
error.unauthorized: Your login has expired. Close this window and start again to log in.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened while connecting to fluks. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This fluks Site is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to fluks. Start the flow again to retry.
abort.missing_registration: Start account creation again before verifying your email.
abort.unauthorized: Authentication expired or is no longer valid. Start the flow again.
abort.unknown: fluks returned an unexpected response. Start the flow again to retry.
